query:
SELECT DISTINCT profissionalNome, COUNT(*) as total 
FROM cashbarberAtendimentos 
WHERE profissionalNome LIKE '%Fábio%' OR profissionalNome LIKE '%Fabio%'
GROUP BY profissionalNome;
